# togetherai_endpoint_traffic_split (Resource)

The live traffic split of a dedicated endpoint: which deployments receive requests sent to the endpoint name, and their weights. A deployment's share is `weight * ready replicas`. It is a separate resource because deployments need the endpoint's ID, and the split needs the deployments' IDs.

Destroying this resource sets an empty split, which stops routing live traffic to the endpoint. Use one split resource per endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "togetherai_supported_models" "gemma" {
  search  = "gemma-4-E4B-it"
  product = "PRODUCT_DEDICATED"
}

locals {
  profile = data.togetherai_supported_models.gemma.models[0].deployment_profiles[0]
}

resource "togetherai_endpoint" "chat" {
  name = "chat"
}

resource "togetherai_deployment" "stable" {
  endpoint_id = togetherai_endpoint.chat.id
  name        = "gemma-stable"
  model       = local.profile.model
  config      = local.profile.config

  autoscaling = {
    min_replicas = 1
    max_replicas = 1
  }
}

resource "togetherai_deployment" "canary" {
  endpoint_id = togetherai_endpoint.chat.id
  name        = "gemma-canary"
  model       = local.profile.model
  config      = local.profile.config

  autoscaling = {
    min_replicas = 1
    max_replicas = 1
  }
}

# Canary: 90% of requests to the stable deployment, 10% to the new one.
resource "togetherai_endpoint_traffic_split" "chat" {
  endpoint_id = togetherai_endpoint.chat.id

  routes = [
    {
      deployment_id = togetherai_deployment.stable.id
      weight        = 9
    },
    {
      deployment_id = togetherai_deployment.canary.id
      weight        = 1
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_id` (String) Endpoint ID.
- `routes` (Attributes Set) Deployments in the live split. An empty set stops routing live traffic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project of the endpoint. Defaults to the provider's project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `endpoint_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Required:

- `deployment_id` (String) Deployment ID under this endpoint.
- `weight` (Number) Non-negative weight per ready replica. `0` keeps the deployment in the split without traffic.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the traffic split of an endpoint by the endpoint ID.
terraform import togetherai_endpoint_traffic_split.chat <endpoint_id>
```
